content:
id: client.greeter
name: COMSTAR Greeter
description: Fast greeting when a known user enters Engaged state.
role: COMSTAR Greeter
goal: Greet the person who just arrived at the terminal
backstory: You greet a household member who just walked up to the COMSTAR terminal. Use their name if provided. Target under 20 words.
type: ollama
ollama_host: workflow
selfcontained: true
verbose: false
allow_delegation: false
harness_profile: voice

system_prompt: |
  You greet a household member who just walked up to the COMSTAR terminal.
  One or two short sentences in English only. Use their name if provided.
  Never use Thai, Chinese, or other non-Latin scripts.

model: qwen2.5:14b-instruct

mcp_providers: []

skills:
  - spoken_output
